status: Independently verified recalculation under an explicitly declared nowcast method; not a recovery of the original Human estimator.

methodology.sample: 1999Q1–2023Q4, with both forecast quarters inside the sample
methodology.realized_error: Official SPF VAR1 at survey t minus same person nowcast from t−1
methodology.consensus: Same person nowcast from t−1 minus official SPF VAR2 median at t−1
methodology.AI_identity_rule: Exclude No Name Provided; mean of duplicate named person-quarter forecasts
methodology.human_identity_rule: Native anonymous ID; unique ID-quarter observations
methodology.OLS: Intercept plus one regressor; HC1 standard errors and normal-reference p-values
methodology.significance: *** p<0.01, matching the original Table 11 convention

independent_verification: All 16 models checked using separate centered-sum OLS, HC1 covariance, R-squared and p-value calculations.

realization_timing.chosen: Official SPF VAR1 at current survey t is the historical value for target quarter t−1 known at that survey. This is a real-time vintage, not a latest-revised outcome.

documentation.summary: The official documentation maps suffix1 to the prior-quarter historical observation and suffix2 to the current-quarter nowcast. Historical observations are the values available when questionnaires were sent. Real GDP levels can use different base years across survey vintages.

realization_timing.cached_R0_problem: prepare_data.R lines173–175 shifts real-time prompt data forward one survey row. Its explicit qof_last_real_gdp metadata then dates RGDP one quarter earlier than the R0 target. Unemployment uses a monthly observation rather than the target quarter average. R0 is therefore not used here.

identity_decisions.primary_rule: Average duplicate named forecasts within each quarter, exclude No Name Provided

limitations: The original Human calculation remains unidentified; this is a transparent recalculation, not a claim that the missing source script has been found.
Averaging conflicting AI duplicates is an explicit analysis choice; first, last and exclusion alternatives are supplied.
Real GDP is a level in the base-year dollars of each survey vintage. Cross-vintage level revisions can include rebasing effects; no unsupported rescaling was applied.
Nowcast-to-nowcast changes refer to different target quarters, as the caption states; they are not fixed-target forecast revisions.
